items.title: 6.11.2 Comparison of entropy values (entropy values ka muqabla) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 6.11.2, printed pages 136-137, with Quick Check 6.8 as self-checks.

blocks.text: Alag alag substances ki entropy ka comparison particles ki tadaad, physical properties aur state (halat) ki basis par kiya ja sakta hai.

Kam particles matlab kam entropy, aur ulta bhi. Misal: CaCO₃ ki standard entropy (92.9 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹) CaO (39.7 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹) se zyada hai, kyun ke particles kam hon to possible arrangements bhi kam hoti hain.

Ek jaisi chemical nature wale substances mein entropy un ki hardness (sakhti) se tay hoti hai. Hard (sakht) substances ki entropy soft (naram) substances se kam hoti hai. Diamond ki entropy graphite se kam hai kyun ke diamond bohat zyada hard hai. Hard substances mein mazboot forces ki wajah se particles kam vibrate kar (hil) sakte hain, is liye disorder ki probability kam hota hai.

Kisi substance ki entropy solid state mein liquid aur gas se kam hoti hai. Melting point ke qareeb barf (ice) ki entropy 48.0 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹, pani ki 69.9 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹, aur boiling point se zara oopar bhaap (water vapour) ki 188.7 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹ hai.
Chai mein cheeni ghulne se solute (cheeni) aur solvent (chai ka pani) dono ki entropy barhti hai.

blocks.prompt: Br₂(l) 151.6 aur I₂(s) 116.8 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹ ki entropy ka farq samjhayein.
blocks.explanation: Bromine liquid hai aur iodine solid. Liquid ke molecules zyada azadi se hil sakte hain, is liye bromine ki entropy zyada hai.

blocks.prompt: H₂(g) 130.6 aur CH₄(g) 186.2 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹ ka farq samjhayein.
blocks.explanation: Dono gas hain, magar methane ke molecule mein 5 atoms hain aur hydrogen mein sirf 2. Zyada atoms matlab energy baantne aur hilne ke zyada tareeqe, is liye CH₄ ki entropy zyada hai.

blocks.prompt: Hg(l) 76.00 aur Na(s) 51.20 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹ ka farq samjhayein.
blocks.explanation: Room temperature par mercury liquid aur sodium solid hai; liquid ki entropy solid se zyada hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: SO₂(g) 248.1 aur SO₃(l) 95.60 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹ ka farq samjhayein.
blocks.explanation: SO₂ gas hai aur SO₃ liquid. Gas ki entropy sab se zyada hoti hai, is liye SO₂ ki entropy kahin zyada hai.

items: Entropy particles ki tadaad ke saath barhti hai (CaCO₃ 92.9 > CaO 39.7).
Soft substance ki entropy zyada (graphite > diamond).
Solid < liquid < gas (barf 48.0, pani 69.9, bhaap 188.7 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹).
